project.title: Eclipse Phase 2e Character & Morph Creator
project.summary: A local-first web tool for creating, validating, saving, resleeving, and printing Eclipse Phase Second Edition characters.

items.title: Confirm licensing and attribution requirements
items.notes: Record the official source, permitted content, and attribution requirements for rules text, artwork, and logos.

items.title: Decide which creation pathways v1 supports
items.notes: Define exact supported options and pick the first workflow to implement from lifepath and point allocation.

items.title: Inventory the rules data and source references
items.notes: Map the selected creation path and sample morphs to source-backed datasets and interpretations.

items.title: Draft and review the core screen wireframes
items.notes: Use docs/design-direction.md to draft and review the dashboard, builder, morph library, and dossier. Review desktop and mobile states and resolve the first printable dossier’s table-ready contents.

items.title: Assign a sourced sample morph
items.notes: The prototype can assign an illustrative morph and save it with a sleeve. Replace the fixtures with a small dataset backed by confirmed rules sources.

items.title: Calculate sleeve stats with a trace
items.notes: The prototype dossier shows a tested aptitude trace and supports incomplete drafts. Confirm calculations against rules sources and exercise the supported sample dataset.

items.title: Complete the first supported creation workflow
items.notes: Add skills, traits, motivations, reputation, and equipment, with tested constraints, a validation ledger, and calculation explanations.

items.title: Browse, filter, and compare supported morphs
items.notes: Show source and restrictions, support comparison of up to three morphs, and resolve launch scope for custom morphs.

items.title: Preserve sleeve history during resleeving
items.notes: Record the event and show old and new derived values side by side while preserving prior sleeve records.

items.title: Export and re-import character backups
items.notes: Validate versioned JSON, report migrations, and verify that a malformed import leaves existing records intact.

items.title: Print player and GM dossiers
items.notes: Add browser print styles and explicit visibility controls for private notes.

items.title: Verify keyboard access, mobile layouts, and print
items.notes: Run the planned accessibility audit and test the complete player workflow across the supported layouts.

items.title: Prepare onboarding and feedback for public beta
items.notes: Document known limitations and cover the planned feedback loop, error monitoring, and privacy-respecting metrics.
